integrity: Exact bijective proof for all finite path sizes; standalone finite verification through n=9; self-review only, no independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The known OEIS unweighted sequence and rational series are not asserted to be novel. The proof concerns only weak directed-path endomorphisms and commuting pairs with one idempotent. An equivalent unindexed combinatorial enumeration remains possible.
title: Joint-rank centralizer census for idempotents of finite directed-path weak endomorphism monoids
